findings.value: A covered market in Spitalfields with permanent shops, food stalls and restaurants, plus weekly antiques and vinyl markets. Time Out calls it a busy shopping hub in east London.

evidence.quote: Open seven days a week, Old Spitalfields Market is one of east London’s busiest shopping hubs.
On Thursdays you’ll also encounter the weekly antiques market
Circling the giant roofed market are numerous permanent boutiques, eateries and salons
Browse Vintage and Rare Records at the Vinyl Market

notes: Time Out's page (29 May 2025) says the market is open Mon-Fri 8am–11pm and Sat-Sun 9am–11pm; the venue's site gives different hours (facts aspect). Its own site prints event dates without a year.
